timeline.summary: Xander measures Anhelo for a new outfit and shares worries about Halo supply.
timeline.quote: "The balance of power in this town is shifting."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Xander orders Anhelo to secretly learn about the Cabaretti's rumored new Halo supply in the Mezzio.
timeline.quote: gather the information on what this source is by whatever means necessary.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Xander retreats to a hidden room of ancient texts on New Capenna's founding.
timeline.quote: Statues of winged angels were locked in stony prayer

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 1: Homecoming" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Perrie delivers the boy to wardens who wipe his memory and school him in secret.
timeline.quote: "He won't remember a thing before today," the warden says.

citation.text: "The Contract Breaker" by Tobias S. Buckell. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: At a Park Heights drop-off, Elspeth meets the planeswalker Vivien, who promises information on a looming threat.
timeline.quote: "One most certainly is, and we share motivations. I'm Vivien, by the way."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth declines to leave with Vivien, wanting to learn how New Capennans beat the threat; Vivien agrees to contact her later.
timeline.quote: "I'll look further into these matters also and contact you when I have more information."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Anhelo takes Elspeth to the Maestros' museum after she agrees to join the family.
timeline.quote: Anhelo had taken her right to the Maestros' museum after Elspeth had agreed to join the family

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Using the notebook's note, Vivien waits at a Halo drop-off point in a park for the Maestro collector.
timeline.quote: This was the drop off point for Halo, and the bag was waiting just as the memo said it would be.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien intercepts Elspeth at the drop-off and catches her wrist; Elspeth admits she is learning the plane's history and is there on Ajani's behalf.
timeline.quote: "Ajani sent me."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth says New Capenna might be her home and that she wants to learn how its people beat a threat before.
timeline.quote: "It might be my home."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien declines to bring Elspeth to Urabrask yet, promising to share information when she has more, and leaves.
timeline.quote: "When I have something worthwhile."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Xander flees to the viewing deck and duels the Adversary, who lands behind him.
timeline.quote: "Did you really think you could escape me?"

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: The Adversary blasts Xander with magic and Xander falls from Park Heights into the clouds below.
timeline.quote: His foot met open air, and he plummeted into the clouds below.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis revels over Xander's mutilated body, and a Maestro informs him that the Font escaped the Crescendo.
timeline.quote: "The Font escaped."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis learns another unaccounted person aided the escape, realizes Xander played him, and vows to find the Font.
timeline.quote: Even from beyond the grave, Xander had played him.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Officers report Jetmir gravely wounded, the Cabaretti neutralized and other families compromised; Ob Nixilis orders the families' heads and a hunt for the Font.
timeline.quote: "I want the families' heads. All of them.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: The pigeons swarm and carry Kitt up to the lowest rim of Park Heights.
timeline.quote: They caught her amid their hundreds of glittering wings and lifted her up and up and up

citation.text: "Alley Cat Blues" by Rhiannon Rasmussen. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Pigeons distract Riveteer lookouts and Kitt catches a train down to the Mezzio.
timeline.quote: A flock of pigeons circled down in a squawking mass

citation.text: "Alley Cat Blues" by Rhiannon Rasmussen. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Obscura enforcers ambush them in the park; Kamiz's trap is revealed and Elspeth, Vivien and Giada flee as Jinnie fights.
timeline.quote: This had all been a setup.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Riveteers fight back in Park Heights, and Elspeth decides New Capenna has its defenders and is not the place to intervene.
timeline.quote: "This isn't the place," she says.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The families rally; Falco's Brokers take position, Della rallies angels, and Parnesse shepherds citizens while Errant heads for the core.
timeline.quote: But, at last, they had worked out the final details.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Converter beasts chase the escaping citizens, and Errant uses Halo paint jars and her sprayer to defeat them.
timeline.quote: Paint sprayed out, swirling with the iridescent rainbows of the Halo with which it was infused.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Errant places the charges in the city's core and finds her Phyrexianized father Anhelo blocking her way.
timeline.quote: Her father stood before her.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Anhelo tries to persuade Errant to join New Phyrexia, and she argues beauty is mess and experimentation.
timeline.quote: "Beauty isn't found by coloring in the lines.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Della's Halo signal shows Atraxa is in position; Errant says goodbye to her father and detonates the core, collapsing Park Heights.
timeline.quote: The core above her burst with orange flame and smoke.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Della catches Errant as she falls from a missed jump and glides her to safety.
timeline.quote: Then, two sturdy arms wrapped themselves around her.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Riveteers hidden in the rafters sever the tower's supports with flame, unseen by Atraxa.
timeline.quote: Tools used to forge connections are now used to sever them violently in gouts of flame.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The gangs collapse Park Heights onto Atraxa, killing her, and the reviving angels go through the omenpaths to attack New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: The gangs formulated a plan to collapse the structure holding Park Heights on Atraxa, killing her.

citation.text: "Capenna", section "Second Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A resistance of families and awakened angels counterattacks, dropping Park Heights on Atraxa in Operation Falling Star.
timeline.quote: dropping the neighborhood on Atraxa and turning the tide against the invaders

citation.text: "New Capenna", section "New Phyrexia's Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Anhelo is compleated, faces Errant to stop her from blowing up Park Heights, fails and dies in the explosion.
timeline.quote: He failed and died in the explosion.

citation.text: "Anhelo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Agents of the remaining families drop Park Heights on Atraxa, killing her.
timeline.quote: She was later found in the rubble, a steel girder impaling her through the chest, killing her.

citation.text: "Atraxa", section "New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In a Park Heights cathedral Giada sacrifices herself, becoming Halo that reinvigorates Elspeth and gives her Luxior to defeat Nixilis.
timeline.quote: she sacrificed herself to save her new friends

citation.text: "Giada", section "New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Giada, restored with Halo, secretly shields Errant as she topples Park Heights and ensures an angel rescues her.
timeline.quote: Giada was there with her every step of the way

citation.text: "Giada", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In her rage, Atraxa obliterates the Museum of Old Capenna.
timeline.quote: Atraxa obliterated the Museum of Old Capenna

citation.text: "Maestros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, the Capennan resistance collapses Park Heights on Atraxa, killing her but destroying the borough.
timeline.quote: the Capennan resistance collapsed Park Heights on Atraxa

citation.text: "Park Heights", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rigo advances to the prestigious firms of Park Heights while mentoring street kids.
timeline.quote: Now a respected Broker in his own right

citation.text: "Rigo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
